meta.title: Message Routing
meta.description: Connect DSH sessions to channels such as QQ, discover destinations and track delivery receipts.

config.enabled: Enable input and cold-session preload. Disabled by default; this does not grant any additional permissions.
config.sendEnabled: Allow external delivery. Each binding also requires its own send switch; enabling may deliver pending replies.
config.continuationEnabled: Allow opt-in extra model requests. Request count is a hard ceiling; token/time budgets only govern admission of the next request. Costs remain actual. Disabled by default.
config.maxRecords: Maximum trace and delivery records (fail closed at capacity)
config.admissionTimeoutMs: Cold resolution and attachment admission timeout (ms)
config.deliveryTimeoutMs: Transport delivery timeout (ms; outcome becomes unknown)

monitor.title: Message routing receipts
monitor.readOnly: View the latest status of received and delivered messages.
monitor.acceptedHint: Accepted means native inbox admission, not message commit, durability or external delivery. Each has its own status.
monitor.unavailable: The read-only monitor is unavailable in this composition.
monitor.failure: The monitor query failed. No work was sent.
monitor.gateHint: These values are diagnostic, not permission to send. Change gates only through the native plugin settings.
monitor.truncated: This page is bounded. Continue to read the remaining records.
monitor.excerpt: Text excerpt; some content is omitted.
